categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Touches descriptor management under src/script/descriptor.{h,cpp} and exposes key expression parsing explicitly needed for wallet and GUI multisig setup flows.
categories.rationale: Exposes key expression parsing and origin inspection to support GUI multisig setup flows in tracking issue #35645, along with fixing trailing character validation in musig descriptors. While it enables the multisig wizard UI to validate and inspect pasted key expressions directly without dummy wrappers, the changes are predominantly interface exposure and minor parser tightening that can be reasonably deferred.
